newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador $200 mln behind on Paris Club debt - Concha.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador $200 mln behind on Paris Club debt - Concha.

text.p: Ecuador is $200 million behind on debt payments to its Paris Club and the government hopes to renegotiate it soon, Finance Minister Pablo Concha said.
Concha, quoted by El Universo newspaper, said Ecuador is $150 million late on principal payments and $50 million on interest.
Ecuador's foreign debt totals $14.288 billion, including $2 billion to the Paris Club debt.
Once this is renegotiated, the government aims to have debt servicing account for 45 percent of state spending in next year's budget, compared with 55 percent this year.
